description.summary: The subject of this spell is protected by floating silver orbs with random symbols on it
description.value: The subject of this spell is protected by floating silver orbs with random symbols on it. The caster can choose one from a list of ailments to block: Bleed, Blinded, Burning, Charmed, Confused, Cursed, Dazed, Dazzled, Deafened, Deprotect, Deshell, Dimmed, Disabled, Diseased, Drenched, Entangled, Fascinated, Fear, Frog, Frozen, Immobilize, Imperil, Mini, Nauseated, Paralyzed, Petrification/Statue, Poisoned, Reverse, Sapped, Sickened, Silenced, Slow, Static, Stunned, Squalled, Weighted, and Zombie. The subject, when hit with that status effect, is nullified and discharges the effect.
